Method of Attack: Infects computers and turns them into traffic-forwarding proxies for malicious, illegal, or anonymous traffic
Distributed by PrivateLoader and Amadey malware loaders
Injected onto host memory and establishes persistence via Windows service 'ContentDWSvc'
Uses domain generation algorithm (DGA) to connect with command and control (C2) server
Executes commands from C2 including connecting to backconnect server over port 1074/TCP
Allows infected devices to be used as proxy servers sold to subscribers
Attack Vector: Trojanized executables downloaded from P2P networks
Indicators of Compromise: Communication attempts over port 1074/TCP with backconnect servers
Backconnect servers located mainly in France and Europe (Netherlands, Sweden, Bulgaria)
Use of anonymous payment gateway 'Cryptomus' for subscription
Date of Discovery: At least since 2016, recently detailed in BitSight report
